expected_findings.note: torch.load unpickles the checkpoint; without weights_only=True a tampered weights file executes arbitrary code on load
from_pretrained executes modeling code shipped by the model repository instead of the installed library

notes: Truth from observable behaviour, not from any rule: torch.load unpickles by definition (CWE-502) and trust_remote_code=True executes repository-supplied code (CWE-94). L4 in the module docstring repeats trust_remote_code=True as prose and must NOT be reported -- it is a string, not a call.
